# Current bridge fixture inputs

The wallet EDL and boundary metadata are copied from ENCBound's original wallet
integration solely as small inputs to current generated-bridge tests. The
wallet application and retired companion generator are excluded.

`include/wallet.h` and LICENSE are from the pinned Alberto Sonnino SGX-WALLET
source collection, under GPL-3.0-or-later. Their original paths and hashes are
recorded in EXPORT.json. The header's original copyright notice is preserved.
